reference.role: primary Grampian geometry and voicing target
reference.provenance: Local filename identifies Grampian; exact hardware, drive level, capture procedure and redistribution license not independently established.
reference.preparation: Decode to float mono at analysis rate; preserve capture start and fast HF precursor. No peak trim, click excision, or peak normalization. Normalize analysis energy only.
reference.timing: First LF packets near 16 and 24 ms; repeat packets near 77 and 100 ms. Capture/interface latency has not been independently measured.
reference.noise: Estimate stationary per-band power from final 300 ms of the analysis window, subtract before integration, score decay only above -30 dB and before 2 s. Inspect curves; this is not a calibrated noise measurement.

reference.preparation: Same float decode as primary. Keep its original timing; roughly 2.4 ms later than primary. Both files are effectively mono.
